name: hostpog
description: HostPog — open-source, AI-native product analytics compatible with existing PostHog installations. Built by DevLabs.

scripts.infra:up: node scripts/with-env.mjs docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait
scripts.infra:down: node scripts/with-env.mjs docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml down
scripts.dev: pnpm db:migrate && node scripts/with-env.mjs pnpm -r --parallel --filter @hostpog/web --filter @hostpog/ingest dev
